name: Pipeliners - Design Audit Local Pages 2026-08-26
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-08-26

# Summary
A running log of city-page design standardization on 2026-08-26. The file as saved begins at section F (earlier sections are not in it) and covers sections F to I.

# F. CTA v2 rollout
- Added to the 29 city pages with no CTA; Cave Creek retro-fixed; all 30 verified.
- **Call-tracking bug found:** GHL `number_pool.js` only swaps numbers in its pool list. CTA templates had hardcoded (480) 447-5345 and (623) 286-3774, which never swapped, so those calls were not attributed. Fixed on 30 pages by using the source number (480) 535-6503 (which swaps) with a number-free aria-label.
- Still open then: 7 CTA v1 pages with the static (623) 286-3774 (Chandler, Avondale, Casa Grande, Apache Junction, Carefree, Anthem, Sacaton), empty alt on the CTA logo.

# G. FAQ design rollout
Template 16699 applied to 18 pages (1,283 widgets compared, 0 content changes). Remaining: 6 nested-accordion pages (Phoenix, Sun City, Mesa, Buckeye, Anthem, Sacaton), 6 OTTO-delivered FAQ pages, 7 with no FAQ. Tempe served 2 FAQPage blocks.

# H. Localized FAQs deployed
8 localized questions each on Surprise, Sun City West, Tolleson, Laveen, Sun Lakes and Rio Verde (Cave Creek skipped, done by hand mid-session). One FAQPage block each, verified. Drafts: [Pipeliners - City FAQ Drafts 7 Pages 2026-08-26](lib:brain-pipeliners-city-faq-drafts-7-pages-2026-08-26).

# I. Reviews block
Template 16703 added to 13 pages; 36 of 37 city pages then carried it (Queen Creek partial). The star image has an empty alt.

# Superseded claims
The FAQ answers used "same-day water" and "licensed ePIPE partners", which are now on the do-not-claim list (Oct 1). Later sessions reworked these pages; see [Pipeliners - Fix Log](lib:brain-pipeliners-fix-log).
